title: Share a required-field validation helper
description: Tech-debt review finding. requireFields and empty-string validators are copy-pasted across scene.ts, session.ts, summary.ts, turnTrace.ts and mutateState.ts, each throwing its own error class. Extract a shared requireNonEmpty helper that takes the error class. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
